d:
A slender, serpentine species with a smooth, pale azure body and a small, rounded head. The eyes are small, dark obsidian circles with a gentle expression. It has a small, single horn of creamy white on its forehead and a small, elegant blue dorsal fin running down its spine. It has no arms and no wings, ending in a tapered, pointed tail of the same pale azure.
BODY COLOR: pale azure
